segments.ja: 森を出た列は、まだ壁の内側の安全には着いていません。着いていない平地で、巨人の群れがもう一度接近します。接近の中に、特別な一体がいます。特別な理由は、速さでも大きさでもありません。エレンの記憶の中の、母が食われた日の顔に似ていることです。似た顔を、ハンネスも見ます。見た瞬間、シガンシナの続きがこの平地に重なります。重なりは、子供だったエレンを現在の体の中へ引き戻します。
segments.en: The column that left the forest has not yet arrived at safety inside the wall. On the flat ground where it has not arrived, a herd of Titans approaches once more. Inside the approach there is one special body. The special reason is not speed and not size. It resembles the face, in Eren's memory, of the day his mother was eaten. Hannes sees the similar face too. At the moment of seeing, the continuation of Shiganshina overlaps this flat ground. The overlap pulls the Eren who was a child back into the present body.

segments.ja: ハンネスは、その一体の前に自分を置きます。置く理由は、司令の計算ではありません。計算ではない理由は、あの日に届かなかった約束です。約束を、彼は今日の刃で埋めようとします。埋めようとする勇気が、技量の差を消しはしません。消さない差の中で、彼はエレンとミカサを後ろへ残します。残す動作が、駐屯の兵士としての最後の配置です。配置は、英雄の型より、近所の大人の型に近いです。
segments.en: Hannes puts himself in front of that one Titan. The reason for putting himself there is not the Commander's calculation. The reason that is not a calculation is a promise that did not arrive on that day. He tries to fill the promise with today's blade. The courage that tries to fill it does not erase the gap in skill. Inside the gap that is not erased, he leaves Eren and Mikasa behind him. The motion of leaving them is his last arrangement as a garrison soldier. The arrangement is closer to the pattern of a neighborhood adult than to the pattern of a hero.

segments.ja: ハンネスの刃は、その巨人の口より先には届きません。届かない結果が、エレンの目の前で完了します。完了は、母の日の反復です。反復を、彼は拳の巨人化で破ろうとします。破ろうとした体が、いつもの筋肉を返しません。返さない理由は、憎しみの不足ではありません。不足ではなく、同じ喪失が二度目だと知ったときの空洞です。空洞の中で、ミカサは彼の腕を引き、それでも逃げ切れません。
segments.en: Hannes's blade does not arrive ahead of that Titan's mouth. The result of not arriving is completed in front of Eren's eyes. The completion is a repeat of his mother's day. He tries to break the repeat by becoming a Titan of fists. The body that tries to break it does not return the usual muscle. The reason it does not return is not a lack of hatred. It is not a lack. It is the hollow of knowing the same loss is happening a second time. Inside the hollow, Mikasa pulls his arm, and still they cannot finish escaping.

segments.en: At the bottom of the hollow, Eren's will takes another shape. The shape it takes is not a larger fist. It is a scream that passes a target to the Titans around him. Later words call the scream the Coordinate. Before they call it that, on the scene, the Titans turn toward the one that smiles. The turned direction opens a way out for Eren and Mikasa. The way that opened is not a way he made by understanding it. Understanding comes afterward. Before it comes, Hannes is already gone.

segments.ja: 向きを変えた巨人は、壁の人間ではなく、指定された一体と、さらに遠くの鎧を襲います。襲う光景は、救出であると同時に、新しい恐怖です。恐怖の中身は、エレンの意思が巨人の意思を上書きできるということです。上書きを、エルヴィンは戦力として見ます。見る顔と、ミカサがハンネスの不在を見る顔は、同じ場にあります。同じ場で、成果と喪失がまた並びます。並ぶことは、この季節の繰り返しです。
segments.en: The Titans that turned attack not the humans of the walls but the one body that was indicated, and the armor farther off. The sight of the attack is a rescue and, at the same time, a new fear. The contents of the fear are that Eren's will can overwrite a Titan's will. Erwin sees the overwriting as fighting power. The face that sees it and the face with which Mikasa sees Hannes's absence are in the same place. In the same place, result and loss line up again. Lining up is the repetition of this season.

segments.ja: 戦士の側にいるユミルの中で、別の子供の記憶が開きます。開く名はマルセルです。マルセルは、彼女が人に戻るために食われた戦士の子供でした。子供は、弟を守るために自分を差し出しました。差し出した選択が、ユミルの第二の人生の開始です。開始を、彼女は罪としてだけは持っていません。持っていない代わりに、誰かを生かす選択の見本として持っています。見本の宛先が、ヒストリアです。
segments.en: Inside Ymir, on the warrior side, another child's memory opens. The name that opens is Marcel. Marcel was the warrior child who was eaten so that she could return to being human. The child offered himself in order to protect a younger brother. The choice he offered is the start of Ymir's second life. She does not hold that start only as a sin. Instead she holds it as a model of a choice that lets someone live. The address of the model is Historia.

segments.ja: ヒストリアは、クリスタに戻れば壁の中で安全だという道を知っています。知っている道を、彼女は今日降りると決めます。決める内容は、ユミルが塔で言った一文の実行です。実行は、期待される良い子をやめることです。やめた顔で、彼女は自分の名を人前で使う準備をします。準備は、まだ王位の話ではありません。王位の前の、一人の人生の話です。話を、彼女は震える声で始めます。
segments.en: Historia knows a road on which she would be safe inside the walls if she returned to being Christa. She decides today to step down from the road she knows. What she decides is the carrying-out of the one sentence Ymir said on the tower. The carrying-out is to stop being the good child who is expected. With the face that stopped, she prepares to use her own name in front of people. The preparation is not yet talk of a throne. It is the talk of one person's life, before a throne. She starts the talk in a voice that shakes.

segments.ja: 記憶は、104期が子供だった季節を短く通ります。通る景色は、飯と、雪と、誰かが誰かを庇った昼です。昼の中に、ライナーの世話と、ユミルの皮肉と、エレンの直進があります。ある景色は、今の敵味方で割れます。割れても、子供だった時間は報告書から消えません。消えない時間を、アルミンは刃の正当化には使いません。使わないことが、彼がまだ子供の記憶を道具にしていない証拠です。
segments.en: Memory passes briefly through the season when the 104th were children. The scenery it passes is meals, snow, and a noon when someone shielded someone. Inside the noon there is Reiner's care, Ymir's sarcasm, and Eren's straight path. The scenery cracks along today's enemies and allies. Even cracking, the time of being children does not vanish from the report. Armin does not use the time that does not vanish to justify a blade. Not using it is evidence he has not yet made the memory of children into a tool.

segments.en: Inside the information Moblit carries, Ragako says its name once more. The hypothesis it puts forward is that the village's people were made into Titans. If they were made so, the absence of a hole is explained. The explanation does not save the face of Connie's mother. The column does not hide the explanation that does not save her because it is cruel. Not hiding it is because it becomes the premise of the next fight. The premise is that the enemy is not only the beast outside the wall, but has a technique that turns humans into Titans.

segments.en: Erwin is carrying, on the same saddle, the arm he lost and the report of the Coordinate he gained. The face that carries them does not belong to a child's memory. The face that does not belong connects the 104th's choices to an adult war. The connection is not only in order to make them tools. It is also because an enemy with a hometown outside the walls is targeting the children inside. The children who were targeted start, today, to give each their answer. The answers they have started to give are not yet aligned.

segments.en: After the Coordinate, Mikasa supports Eren. The arm that supports him stands in for the adults who did not arrive on his mother's day. Being a stand-in also makes her grieve. Even grieving, the arm does not leave. Not leaving is her answer today. The answer is a different kind from Historia's answer. The different answer is on the same flat ground. Being there is evidence that the children do not have one correct solution.

segments.en: After Eren's scream has moved the Titans on the scene, it remains in his throat. The sensation that remains is not the afterglow of victory. It is not an afterglow. It is the sensation that his own will designated the direction of someone's death. Ahead of what he designated is the one body that ate Hannes. He cannot make that fact clean with an explanation of the Coordinate. Unable to make it clean, he opens his eyes inside Mikasa's arm. The eyes he opens are a child's eyes and a soldier's eyes at the same time.
